name: Amy Food Inc
old_description: Amy Food Inc. is a family-owned food producer based in Houston, Texas, focused on frozen Asian-style appetizers. Its product line covers potsticker dumplings, egg rolls, crab rangoon, cream cheese wontons, empanadas and broth, with several items sold under the Jamy's Three Dragon label. about:
Amy Food Inc. is a family-owned food producer headquartered in Houston, Texas. The company describes its history as a 30-year journey rooted in a passion for authentic Asian cuisine, though it does not publish a specific founding year or founder names.

The operation manufactures a line of frozen Asian-style appetizers that includes potsticker dumplings, egg rolls, crab rangoon, cream cheese wontons, empanadas, and broth. A distinguishing feature is the in-house production of egg roll wrappers. Items are sold under the Jamy's Three Dragon label in pork, chicken, and vegetable varieties, shipped frozen, and formulated for baking, deep frying, air frying, or pan searing.

The company serves foodservice and retail customers, distributing to restaurants, institutional kitchens, and grocery retailers. Specific client references are not provided.

Amy Food highlights its three-decade heritage and adherence to time-honored recipes as the foundation of its product quality, aiming to deliver flavors that taste like home cooking.
